svg.aria-label: Type checkers at scale, 10k to one million modules: whole-program check (tsgo vs tsc vs Flow), the red-gate premium, the one-edit save loop by mechanic, completion, and Flow's wedge under edit pressure; each cell shows its measured time and its multiple of the row's fastest.
svg.text: tsgo 7.0.2 · tsc 6.0.3 (64GB heap) · flow main @ cdb4f637 (wedge fixes in) · 64-core host.
Each cell: the measured time, then its multiple of the row's fastest. A timeout shows its ceiling as a floor (≥); a crash shows status,
Warm full check, no incremental state. tsc stops at the 100k anchor: a cost cutoff, not a capacity limit. Flow is a build of flow main with the wedge fixes
(provenance in the JSON); released 0.321's server crashes at this scale (last section).
A failing check costs what a passing one costs
Each cell: the red run against the green run, at the checker's largest measured scale. The red run seeds 3 errors in zero-dependent leaf modules and must exit nonzero
One edit to a verdict: the save loop, by mechanic
Squiggle: the asserted didChange → TS2322 → clear transition on a live server. Flow server: a force-recheck + status round-trip. CLI: a relaunch on warm incremental
state. Released Flow 0.321's server wedges under overlapping edits at this scale (facebook/flow#9454, last section).
Completion: different result sets, reported with counts
Not like-for-like: tsgo returns the full exported-symbol space (31,058 items at 10k, 301,058 at 100k); tsserver returns a bounded 1,067-entry set. The × prices the
response a user waits for. From 250k up tsgo exceeds its 120s request ceiling; tsserver stops at the 100k anchor.
Flow's wedge under edit pressure: released 0.321.0 vs flow main
Storm: a second edit lands 120–480ms into an in-flight recheck, the trigger behind all three recorded wedges. 500k corpus. Settled sequential edits never trigger it
on either binary. Fix verified on flow main (facebook/flow#9454).
